upgrades.lead: Your extra copies can upgrade a card: it changes look and its stats go up a little.
upgrades.how1: One copy of each card always stays in your collection: only extra copies are used.
upgrades.how2: Levels unlock in order: Golden ★, then Golden ★★, then Divine ★★★.
upgrades.how3: The rarer the card, the fewer copies you need (table below).
upgrades.how4: Each level raises HP, attack, defense and speed, up to +{max}% at Divine.
upgrades.how5: A star appears on the artwork for each level: gold for Golden, white and silver for Divine.
upgrades.sell1: On a card's page, “Sell” sells all its extra copies at once.
upgrades.sell2: “Sell my extra copies” does the same for your whole collection.
upgrades.sell3: Commons, rares and epics earn at most {cap} MemeMoney per day; rarer cards have no limit.
upgrades.sell4: Small amounts (0.1, 0.25…) add up and are never lost.

memeMoney.what: MemeMoney is the game's currency. Your balance is shown at the top right; tap it to open the Shop.
memeMoney.earnWin: Win a ranked battle: +{amount} MemeMoney (battles are coming soon).
memeMoney.earnRanks: Reach a new rank for the first time: up to {total} MemeMoney in total, plus boosters (see Ranks).
memeMoney.earnSell: Sell your extra copies (see Upgrades), up to {cap} MemeMoney per day for commons, rares and epics.
memeMoney.earnShop: Buy it in the Shop with real money, from {price}.
memeMoney.earnFirst: Your very first top-up gives twice as much MemeMoney.
memeMoney.spendWhere: These boosters are bought on the Boosters page of the home screen, then opened whenever you like.
memeMoney.rule1: MemeMoney has no real-money value: it can't be resold, refunded or converted into money.
memeMoney.rule2: It can't be traded between players.
memeMoney.rule3: Fractions earned by selling cards are kept and add up.
memeMoney.rule4: Real-money purchases are for people aged {age} and over, capped at {cap} per 30-day period.

trophies.what: Trophies measure your level in ranked battles. The more you have, the higher your rank and the stronger your opponents.
trophies.floor: You can never go below 0 trophies.
trophies.bots: Battles against a bot don't change your trophies.
trophies.soon: Ranked battles are coming soon: until then, your trophies don't move.
trophies.use1: Every {per} trophies, you move up a rank (see Ranks).
trophies.use2: Each new rank reached for the first time gives boosters and MemeMoney.
trophies.use3: The game matches you with opponents who have a similar number of trophies.
trophies.use4: They place you against other players in the Ranking tab.
trophies.where1: At the top left of the screen, next to your rank.
trophies.where2: In your Profile, with a chart of how they change.
trophies.where3: In the Ranking: around you, in your rank or worldwide.
